comment: The medians are the ubuntu-latest runner's (4 vCPU; run 39087 on ci/card-532, 2026-10-18), not a developer machine's: this machine walks the same tree in 26 ms, the runner in 165 ms. Tolerance is 30% because one runner varies against another. A run fails when its median exceeds the baseline times (1 + tolerance). Re-record from a runner's printed median, not with --update here.
